Tasty local cuisine, with no MSG
Sep 2026 • Solo
What a wonderful find, and by accident as I was out for a short walk near the Imperial Citadel. The hostess spoke English and as I am very allergic to MSG, called various things depending on where you are in Vietnam, it was wonderful to finally be confident that I could order and eat something without it. We looked at menu and after finding out what I was interested in she took my order to the cook. I had the most delicious and tasty fresh fig salad and shrimp. I am going back tonight. Lovely decor as well.

Delicious local cuisine in the heart of Huê
Jul 2026 • Family
One of the many restaurant options in these car- and motorcycle-free streets of Huê, but a good choice!
We got a table at the window on the first floor and it was cozy sitting there with a nice view of the street (and a well-functioning A/C). The menu is very well maintained (with representative photos) and plenty of choice, including local specialties. 
We went for the bún bò Huê (noodle soup with beef), the bánh khoái (crispy pancake with scampi and pork), the bánh loc (tapiocak noodles stuffed with shrimp and pork, lay us a little less) and the tasty nem lazy (grilled chopped pork on a lemongrass stickie). All dishes were beautifully presented and tasted very good, especially with a Huda from the barrel. 
The staff was very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.

Exceptional flavors!
Jun 2026 • Couples
This restaurant is simply extraordinary. I am not in the habit of leaving comments, but I think this is a gem, and I want to share it with others. 
My wife and I found everything delicious during our lunch yesterday, and we wanted to check if it was just a stroke of luck, but no, our two new dishes were just as delicious, and we did not choose the most expensive dishes. 
In summary, even though this restaurant is a bit more expensive than a simple street food restaurant, the flavors are truly exceptional. Without wanting to overstate, I believe this is the best Asian restaurant I have ever eaten at!
